dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Release - Health and Regression
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for deploy markers, before/after latency, throughput, errors, logs, new exceptions, and rollback decision signals. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(timestamp), latest(revision), latest(changelog), latest(user) FROM Deployment WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET deploymentId LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago

widgets.title: Error rate before and after deploy

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND level IN ('warning', 'error', 'critical') FACET level TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET error.class, deployment.version LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT percentile(duration, 95), percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET deployment.version LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Confirm marker, compare latency, throughput, errors, and logs, then drill into APM, logs, traces, or rollback runbooks.
